Package com.nexuslink.protocol.http.rest

Class TraceContext

java.lang.Object
com.nexuslink.protocol.http.rest.TraceContext
public final class TraceContext extends Object
Pure, dependency-free model of the W3C Trace Context (Level 1) distributed-tracing headers, traceparent and tracestate.

This class carries no networking: it parses/validates the two headers, generates fresh ids from a SecureRandom, derives child contexts, and injects the pair back into an outgoing header map. All identifiers are lowercase hex as required by the spec.

traceparent

Format version-traceid-parentid-flags. For version 00 that is 00-<32 hex>-<16 hex>-<2 hex>. Rejected inputs: wrong field count, non-(lowercase-)hex fields, an all-zero trace-id, an all-zero parent-id, and — for version 00 — any trailing data after the flags. The parent-id is also known as the span-id; the low bit of the flags (0x01) is the sampled flag.

tracestate

See the nested TraceContext.TraceState.

Instances are immutable; mutating operations return new instances.

    • childOf

      public static TraceContext childOf(String traceparent)
      Derives a child of the given traceparent header value: same trace-id, a fresh random parent-id, and preserved flags. The returned context has an empty tracestate (a traceparent string carries none); use child() to preserve an in-model tracestate.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if traceparent is malformed
